name: Ombel Packaging Records for WooCommerce
author: ombel

sections.description:
Ombel records the packaging used for new WooCommerce orders. Create
packaging profiles with component weights, assign them to products and
variations, include shipping packaging, and review your local records.

The bundled local features remain free, with no expiry or account requirement:

  • Packaging profiles, component weights and version history.
  • Product and variation assignment, bulk assignment and CSV import/export.
  • Order packaging snapshots, local ledger and material totals.
  • Missing-data review, registration records and an audit log.
  • Local preparation views for manual review and export of your own CSV data.
  • Diagnostics that exclude credentials, customer details and raw payloads.

Local recording works without a cloud service and does not block checkout.
Historical orders are not automatically backfilled. A monetary refund does
not automatically deduct packaging mass. Multisite is outside this release’s
scope.

This is a packaging records and preparation tool. It does not certify legal
compliance, determine your obligations, verify official registrations, create
official filing exports or submit declarations. Country guidance and rule
content require your own review. Store records may exclude other sales
channels or producer-wide quantities. Keep your registration and filing process.

Spain adds factual business and packaging details, preserved order snapshots,
and an internal annual view with explicit missing facts. Poland adds annual
recorded material totals and your own administrative CSV for manual review.
Neither view decides producer responsibility or validates complete business
coverage. No official Spanish RPP/Ecoembes or Polish BDO output or submission
is available. Recorded offsets are not validated as Polish reporting deductions.

Denmark adds recorded year and quarter totals, unverified business facts,
component facts preserved for new orders, and saved preparation JSON with
gross weights by declared household or commercial use. Older unknown facts
remain unknown. No producer-role, eligibility or DPA/VANA filing decision,
official upload or automatic submission is available.

Guided example

Try this with sample products and a controlled test order on a test shop:

  1. Open a product’s Shipping tab. In “Create and assign product packaging
    here”, name a sales profile “Bottle v1” and add two components: 24 g
    paper/cardboard and 1 g plastic. The total is 25 g. Save other product
    edits first, then create, activate and assign the packaging in one action.
  2. Reuse this active profile on 12 products: open Packaging > Bulk assignment,
    select their category and “Bottle v1”, preview, review the selected scope
    and apply. The same profile can be reused without entering its weights again.
  3. For SKU imports, export the assignment CSV and keep its column names. Add
    each product’s SKU and the exact profile_uuid from the profile export.
    Upload once, review “Would assign”, “Would skip” and errors, then apply
    the saved preview. The final result shows what was actually changed.
  4. Set a default shipping profile with 180 g paper/cardboard and 7 g plastic:
    187 g for the parcel. Before the order is recorded, its order panel can
    keep this default, select another active shipping profile, or explicitly
    omit shipping packaging when that matches the physical parcel.
  5. Complete a qualifying test order containing two units using “Bottle v1”.
    Run the background queue and check the order panel: 50 g product packaging
    plus 187 g shipping gives 237 g. Material totals are 228 g paper/cardboard
    and 9 g plastic. With no packaging corrections, gross and net are equal.
  6. Open Reports to download your administrative material CSV for the chosen
    period, country and material. Review missing-data counts as well as g/kg
    totals. This is your own-records CSV for review, not an official filing.
  7. Clone the profile to a new version when packaging changes. After activation,
    review its migration preview before moving future assignments. The order
    already recorded retains its 237 g and the original version. Older profiles
    without a recorded version relationship use ordinary reviewed bulk assignment.

An incomplete historical order remains marked incomplete after repairing its
current product. A failed recording can be retried from its order panel only
when the original frozen recording context is available. This does not
automatically backfill old orders or change their historical figures.

External services and privacy

This version runs locally without an external service, account or subscription.
Packaging data stays on your WordPress site. No cloud connection or paid
checkout is offered in this version.

The plugin stores packaging materials and weights, destination countries,
local order identifiers and pseudonymous order references. It does not copy
customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses or payment
details into its packaging records. Avoid personal information in profile
names and business notes. References are pseudonymous, not anonymous: your
store can associate them with its WooCommerce orders.

No automatic retention expiry or personal-data exporter/eraser is implemented.
Review the retention and erasure requirements that apply to your store.
Deactivation and normal plugin deletion preserve packaging records. Intentional
full deletion requires BRIGHTFERN_PPWR_ALLOW_DATA_WIPE developer configuration;
back up your data before using it.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce. Use WordPress 6.4+, WooCommerce 8.0+ and
    PHP 8.1+. Back up your site and database.
  2. Install this plugin and activate it.
  3. Open Ombel > Setup and enter the business facts you know. Unknown
    information may remain unanswered.
  4. Create a packaging profile with a positive component weight in grams,
    assign it to a product or variation, and configure shipping packaging.
  5. Process a controlled new order and review Overview and Missing data.
sections.faq:
Is this a time-limited trial?

No. The bundled local recording and preparation features remain free.

Does it file official declarations?

No. Review your obligations and complete official reporting manually.
Official filing exports stay unavailable.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce order APIs with HPOS and legacy order storage.

How do I get support?

Contact info@brightfernlabs.com with plugin/WP/Woo/PHP versions, the affected
page, action, time and a reviewed Diagnostics report. Exclude customer details,
passwords, cookies, session tokens and official portal credentials.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Add local Denmark year and quarter preparation with exact material totals and administrative CSV.
  • Save unverified business facts and component details for new Danish orders.
  • Preserve preparation JSON and gross weights by declared use for manual review.
  • Keep earlier unknown facts visible and official DPA/VANA exports and submissions unavailable.

1.0.4

  • Add local Spain preparation: business facts, packaging details and an internal annual view.
  • Add Poland recorded annual material totals and administrative CSV for manual review.
  • Keep historical order evidence, missing-data warnings and local access without a cloud account.
  • Official RPP, Ecoembes and BDO exports and submissions remain unavailable.

1.0.3

  • Choose default, alternative or no shipping packaging before an order is recorded.
  • Download administrative material CSVs with period, country, material and g/kg totals.
  • Add Dutch translations and clearer Ombel navigation.
  • Preview and migrate future assignments to explicitly linked profile versions.
  • Improve keyboard-accessible tables and narrow-screen layouts; add a guided example.
  • Offer safe explicit retries for failed recordings with preserved original context.
  • Preserve the original destination country during delayed processing and retries.
  • Fix scan restarts, setup weight validation, atomic setup/report storage and explicit-wipe cleanup.

1.0.2

  • Create, activate and assign product packaging directly from the product editor.
  • Apply saved CSV previews and recheck bulk selections before queuing.
  • Show analysis refresh progress and distinguish current coverage from historical order records.
  • Keep actual CSV import results visible when follow-up work fails.

1.0.1

  • Fix variation saves, removing packaging assignments and editing draft materials.
  • Preserve packaging records across retries, delayed jobs and deactivation.
  • Fix CSV round trips, bulk variation batches and duplicate batch progress.
  • Improve input validation, incomplete-data reporting and intentional data removal.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org submission candidate with permanent local packaging
    recording and preparation.
  • Official filing exports remain unavailable.
